proposed_comments.title: Preserve HICON transparency when materializing binary icons
proposed_comments.body:
### Preserve HICON transparency when materializing binary icons

**Severity:** `high`

`Icon.ToBitmap()` flattens HICON transparency before the pixels are copied into the `SoftwareBitmap`, so transparent shell-icon pixels are turned into opaque dark backgrounds. That changes the behavior from the removed native conversion path and breaks extracted icons that rely on alpha or legacy AND-mask transparency. Please render the icon through a 32-bit DIB or another native bitmap path that preserves alpha, then premultiply or reconstruct mask transparency before creating the `SoftwareBitmap`.

confidence.rationale: The reproduced fix preserves both transparent and visible pixels, and the final focused test run proves the regression on the current extraction path.

proposed_comments.title: Avoid per-icon large-object-heap churn during extraction
proposed_comments.body:
### Avoid per-icon large-object-heap churn during extraction

**Severity:** `medium`

At the default 256×256 size, the current extraction path allocates a 262,144-byte managed buffer for every binary icon load. That lands on the large object heap and can churn heavily when providers enumerate many distinct icons. Please rent the staging buffer from `ArrayPool<byte>` or copy directly into a locked `SoftwareBitmap` buffer so repeated icon loads do not keep allocating new LOH arrays.

confidence.rationale: The allocation size is deterministic from the current code path, and the validated review-branch fix removes the per-icon LOH allocation without changing behavior.

proposed_comments.title: Remove the unused System.Drawing.Common dependency from the app project
proposed_comments.body:
### Remove the unused System.Drawing.Common dependency from the app project

**Severity:** `medium`

The converter no longer uses `System.Drawing.Common`: the implementation relies on Win32 icon extraction and `SoftwareBitmap`, and the existing `System.Drawing.Point` call already compiled before this package was added. Keeping the reference adds an unnecessary package/runtime dependency to the CmdPal UI app. Please remove the package reference.

```suggestion
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.Windows.SDK.BuildTools" />
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.WindowsAppSDK" />
    <PackageReference Include="Microsoft.Xaml.Behaviors.WinUI.Managed" />
    <PackageReference Include="WinUIEx" />
```

confidence.rationale: The current head adds the package explicitly, while the converged review branch removes it and still rebuilds the app project successfully.

proposed_comments.title: Remove the unused System.Drawing.Common dependency from the test project
proposed_comments.body:
### Remove the unused System.Drawing.Common dependency from the test project

**Severity:** `medium`

None of the linked helper sources or the focused unit tests use `System.Drawing.Common`; the managed converter now uses Win32 P/Invokes and `SoftwareBitmap` directly. Keeping the package here restores and deploys a dependency that the test assembly does not need. Please remove the extra reference.

```suggestion
  <ItemGroup>
    <PackageReference Include="MSTest" />
  </ItemGroup>
```

confidence.rationale: The review branch removes the package from the test project, the unit-test project rebuilds, and the focused 38-test run remains green.
